asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software and billing services run by staff; no plants, fleets or property needed to grow.

big_ticket.reason: Subscriptions and percentage-based billing fees paid regularly by practices; small, frequent payments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Healthcare practices need EHR and billing to operate and get paid; spending is not easily postponed.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are small and mid-size medical practices, though some larger organizations and hospitals (Medsphere) are served.

notes: Revenue mix between software and RCM services is judged from general knowledge; RCM services are the larger part.

offers_products.reason: Cloud EHR, practice management and cirrusAI software platforms are main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Revenue cycle management billing and collections services done by its staff for practices are a main offering.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from its cloud software platform and AI tools, though RCM staff contribute.

recurring_revenue.reason: SaaS subscriptions and ongoing RCM billing services for 40,000 providers recur monthly.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells EHR, billing and AI tools to medical practices; patients only use the tools, providers buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are medical practices, therapy groups and hospitals (via Medsphere) purchasing EHR and RCM.
